instructions.name: absorb_reveal_chunks
docs: Copy packed reveal chunks into `deck_staging` and close them.
Remaining accounts are `(chunk, refund)` pairs. Rent returns to the
wallet recorded when the chunk was written. The lane that paid for the
account only keeps its signature budget.

instructions.name: add_casino_admin
docs: CAdmin delegates a key that may administer this casino's rooms and tables.

instructions.name: add_casino_dealer
docs: A delegated casino admin registers a dealer key for one game kind.

instructions.name: add_to_whitelist
docs: Add a player pubkey to the room whitelist. Only [`WHITELIST_ADMIN`] may call.

accounts.name: admin
docs: CAdmin, or a delegated admin of this room's casino.

instructions.name: apply_casino_player_net
docs: Testing / localnet only — caller-chosen net would mint/drain game escrow.
Do not ship in release until nets are bound to a one-time outcome receipt.

instructions.name: begin_showdown_material
docs: Create the canonical sealed-limb reveal coverage registry for one
showdown generation and recipient.

instructions.name: begin_verify_deck_hash
docs: Reset accumulator / bitset and latch the expected Poseidon(4) sum.

instructions.name: begin_verify_share_hash
docs: Initialize one player's recipient-major share hash verification.

instructions.name: buy_in_room
docs: Legacy alias for init_room_wallet.

instructions.name: close_deck_staging
docs: Close the deck staging PDA and refund all rent to the staging authority.
Can only be called after all partials have been revealed and showdown
has been accepted. Phase 5 is that showdown. Poker later advances to
phase 6, and house settlement sets `SETTLEMENT_SETTLED` without that
advance. Bingo settles the buy-in pot without a dealer pool, so it
stays on phase 5.
Authority must be `game_state.staging_authority` (deck staging rent payer).

instructions.name: close_revealed_card
docs: Close a `RevealedCard` PDA and refund rent to the authority.

instructions.name: close_seat_rent
docs: Return hand-scoped rent (MPC key, share accumulator, showdown material,
pending deposit) to this player's vault. The hand must already be finished.

instructions.name: close_share_deck_staging
docs: Close a per-player `share_deck_staging` PDA after `finalize_share_phase`.
Authority must be `game_state.staging_authority` (staging rent payer).
Rent is refunded only to that key — prevents outsider rent theft.

instructions.name: collect_blinds
docs: Testing only: plaintext blind mint without Enc seat debit.
Production blinds must debit the canonical Enc hand ledger.

accounts.name: encrypted_game_betting
docs: Required for testing collect_blinds (Enc betting path present).

accounts.name: sealed_showdown_coefficients
docs: Seat-wallet seal. Settlement marks it consumed. The owner must be the
showdown submitter's seat.

accounts.name: authority
docs: light-casino `cpi_authority` PDA. No other signer may call this.

accounts.name: authority
docs: light-casino `cpi_authority` PDA. No other signer may call this.
Must be mutable and funded — pays rent for the poker `PlayerState` PDA.

instructions.name: create_casino
docs: CAdmin opens a tenant bound to this program and light-casino.

instructions.name: create_deck_staging
docs: Create a staging PDA for encrypted deck data.
The PDA size depends on the number of players:
- 2 players:  25 cards × 4 values  = 100 values  = 3,200 bytes
- 5 players:  25 cards × 16 values = 400 values  = 12,800 bytes
- 10 players: 25 cards × 36 values = 900 values  = 28,800 bytes
Rent is fully refunded when the PDA is closed via `close_deck_staging`.
Create a staging PDA for encrypted deck data (first chunk).
Solana caps CPI realloc at 10 KiB per instruction, so the full
28,840-byte staging account is grown via `extend_deck_staging`.
Uses `UncheckedAccount` so Anchor does not stack-allocate
Rent is fully refunded when the PDA is closed via `close_deck_staging`.

accounts.name: deck_staging
docs: Not `Account<DeckStaging>` — that would stack-allocate 28,800 bytes on init.

accounts.name: authority
docs: CAdmin, or a delegated casino admin. The handler checks which.

accounts.name: authority
docs: CAdmin, or a delegated admin of this room's casino.

accounts.name: pending_deposit
docs: SPL deposit entitlement consumed later by `request_credit_room_balance`.

accounts.name: sealed_showdown_coefficients
docs: Seat-wallet seal. Settlement marks it consumed. The owner must be the
showdown submitter's seat.

instructions.name: end_hand
docs: Testing only until all-seat settlement is release-reachable.
Production hands end via authenticated settlement/refund callbacks.

instructions.name: extend_deck_staging
docs: Grow `deck_staging` by up to 10 KiB toward [`DECK_STAGING_ACCOUNT_SIZE`].
Call repeatedly after `create_deck_staging` until
`account.data_len() == DECK_STAGING_ACCOUNT_SIZE`.

instructions.name: faucet_credit_personal
docs: Localnet / test faucet: credit a player's personal room escrow (`balance_u64`).
Does not move SPL — use `deposit_spl` + `request_credit_room_balance` for vault-backed
encrypted credits. Whitelisted player (or room admin via payer) may call.
Testing builds only — must not ship in release (inflates plaintext escrow).

instructions.name: finalize_share_phase
docs: Bind every consumed Groth16 share receipt to that player's Arcis hash.
Remaining accounts are pairs `[share_verify_acc, light_proof_receipt]`
in player-index order.

instructions.name: fund_player_game_escrow
docs: Lock stake from `table_escrow` into `player_game_escrow` for the current hand.

instructions.name: hash_deck
docs: Hash a deck of 900 BN254 commitments using the cross-field polynomial hash.
This produces the same result as the Circom circuit for ZK verification.
Returns [u8; 32] — the full 256-bit hash (max < 2^239, fits in both BN254 and Ed25519).

instructions.name: init_apply_casino_player_net_comp_def
docs: Testing / localnet only — arbitrary `player_net_abs` would mint/drain escrow
in release. Production must bind nets to a consumed casino outcome receipt.

instructions.name: init_dealer_pool
docs: Initialize shared Dealer Pool for a casino table.
`game_kind` must match the table. Poker and bingo are rejected: those
prizes are player pots, not a house bankroll.

instructions.name: init_player_mpc_key
docs: Publish a purpose-separated random X25519 public key for one seat/generation.
Requires a registered `PlayerState` for the seat. When the game is bound to
a table, the signer must be the seated player for that hand index.

accounts.name: table_state
docs: When present, signer must be the seated player for `player_index`.

instructions.name: init_player_state
docs: Create a `PlayerState` PDA without a Groth16 register receipt.
Testing only — production initializes via `consume_register_receipt`.

instructions.name: init_protocol_treasury
docs: Protocol treasury for transparent commission accrual per room.

instructions.name: init_redeem_dealer_pool_comp_def
docs: Disabled in release: redemption value is caller-chosen, not share-derived.

instructions.name: init_settle_casino_hand_comp_def
docs: Disabled in release: Arcis output updates only the pool, not player ledgers.

instructions.name: init_stake_dealer_pool_comp_def
docs: Disabled in release: Arcis cannot authenticate transfer success vs insufficient-balance no-op.

instructions.name: initialize_game
docs: Initialize a GameState PDA to track verification and reveal progress.
Call this once at game start, before any Arcis operations.
`num_players` determines how many partials each card needs (n-1).

accounts.name: player
docs: Writable so sit-out and leave can receive the rent-vault balance.

instructions.name: open_preflop
docs: Open preflop betting (`betting_phase` 0 → 1).
Streets advance only via Enc bet-callback
[`advance_betting_street_on_chain`] — callers cannot select Flop/Turn/River/Showdown.

instructions.name: record_reveal
docs: Record that partials have been revealed.
Call this after each successful Arcis reveal callback and Light Protocol
storage. `count` is the number of partials revealed (not cards).
For a `reveal_card` call that returns all partials for one card,
count = num_players - 1.
Authority must be `game_state.staging_authority` (deck staging rent payer).
`count` is in partial units (not limbs) and cannot exceed remaining total.

instructions.name: redeem_dealer_pool
docs: Disabled in release until redemption value is derived from shares + authenticated transfer.

instructions.name: remove_from_whitelist
docs: Remove a player from the room whitelist. Only [`WHITELIST_ADMIN`] may call.

accounts.name: admin
docs: CAdmin, or a delegated admin of the room that owns this entry.

instructions.name: reopen_share_for_next_chunk
docs: Re-open Share after a prefix finalize so the next BJ chunk can verify.
Keeps `verified` + `shared_cards` so cards already in the prefix stay
revealable. Clears `share_finalized` / `shared_mask` and returns phase
to Share. Pair with light-casino `extend_share_chunks`.

accounts.name: pending_deposit
docs: Must hold a positive SPL-backed entitlement from `deposit_spl`.

instructions.name: return_player_game_escrow
docs: Return remaining hand stake from `player_game_escrow` to `table_escrow`.

instructions.name: seal_showdown_pair
docs: Seal both coefficients and reveal their combined rows in one callback.
The account belongs to the seat wallet. A written seal that settlement has
not consumed is reused. A consumed seal, or one opened under a different
key, is reset and sealed again. A live pending callback is left in place.

instructions.name: set_pot_amounts
docs: Set pot amounts on a GameState (testing builds only).
Production path: pot amounts live in `EncryptedGameBetting` ciphertexts;
`distribute_and_settle` reads encrypted state inside MPC.

instructions.name: set_showdown_hash
docs: Set the showdown_hash on a GameState (testing builds only).
Production path: verify showdown via Groth16 in light-casino, then call
`distribute_and_settle` with the resulting hash commitment.

instructions.name: set_verified
docs: Mark deck hash verified (testing builds only).
Production path: set by `verify_deck_hash_chunk` callback when the fold matches.

instructions.name: settle_casino_hand
docs: Disabled in release: caller-selected outcomes/fees; Arcis updates pool only.
Arcis rejects the job when `showdown_results` is outside that game's range.

instructions.name: sit_out
docs: Drop the in-hand flag between hands and return the rent vault to the player.
The seat and chip balance stay.

accounts.name: player
docs: Writable so sit-out and leave can receive the rent-vault balance.

instructions.name: stake_dealer_pool
docs: Disabled in release until Arcis exposes authenticated transferred value.

instructions.name: start_betting_round
docs: Testing-only: legacy phase-arg entry (idempotent same-street / open preflop).
Release builds expose [`open_preflop`] only — no caller-selected street jumps.

instructions.name: start_hand
docs: Link a seated table to an existing (or freshly created) `GameState`.
The signer must be whitelisted for the room and already seated at this
table. Creating the room and the table stays with [`WHITELIST_ADMIN`].
Prefer `initialize_game` first when the hand also needs ZK fields
(`num_cards`, verify bits, etc.). `init_if_needed` keeps room-only
flows working when no GameState exists yet.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Whitelisted player seated at this table. Not the room creator.

instructions.name: submit_bet
docs: Queue an encrypted bet. `show_on_fold` applies only when folding (`action == 0`);
default `false` mucks hole cards.

instructions.name: sync_showdown_material
docs: Synchronize authenticated `RevealedCard` coverage for this showdown.
Remaining accounts must be exactly the recipient-major `RevealedCard`
PDAs for card indices `0..num_players*2+5`, ordered by card index.
Their resealed ciphertext limbs remain on those PDAs; this registry
records only complete-card coverage and never stores a digest.

instructions.name: sync_verify_deck_hash
docs: Copy the callback-owned verification state into GameState.
This intentionally stays outside the Arcium callback so callback
delivery touches only `VerifyDeckHashAccumulator`.
Authority must be `game_state.staging_authority`; progress is monotonic.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Deck staging rent payer — sole party allowed to latch verify state.

instructions.name: transfer_personal_to_seat
docs: Transfer chips from personal room escrow into this seat's table escrow.
Rejected while the player is in an active hand at this table.
Testing-only: plaintext ledger move (diverges from Enc). Release uses
`lock_table_buyin` Enc path instead.

instructions.name: transfer_seat_to_personal
docs: Return seat escrow chips to personal room escrow.
Rejected while a hand is in progress for this player/table (seat is locked to pot).
Testing-only: plaintext ledger move (diverges from Enc). Release uses
`unlock_table` Enc path instead.

accounts.name: game_state
docs: Continuous-hand GameState (`seeds = [b"game_state", game_id]`).

accounts.name: deck_staging
docs: Must be present so queue_computation can reference the account data.

accounts.name: verify_accumulator
docs: and contents are validated by the callback.

instructions.name: verify_share_hash_chunk
docs: Decrypt one batch of a player's staged share. Starts are limb-aligned.
The job does not hash the plaintext; reveal delivers it later.

instructions.name: withdraw_protocol_commissions
docs: Transfer accrued protocol commissions from the room vault (admin only).

instructions.name: write_deck_staging
docs: Write limb-aligned bytes into the game's `deck_staging` PDA.
Account seeds bind the target — there is no generic `target` account.
Authority: any seated player; freezes after legacy deck-hash verify
(see [`require_staging_write_authorized`]).

accounts.name: table_state
docs: Table that owns this hand; membership checked in the handler.

instructions.name: write_reveal_chunk
docs: Store one packed reveal range in its own chunk account.
The lane pays for the account, so several chunks can land in one slot.
`absorb_reveal_chunks` copies them into `deck_staging`.

accounts.name: refund
docs: Rent returns here when the chunk is absorbed. The lane signs the write,
so it consents to this destination. The same wallet can be named by
every parallel chunk.

instructions.name: write_share_deck_staging
docs: Write limb-aligned bytes into per-player `share_deck_staging`.
Account seeds bind `[share_deck_staging, game_id, player_index]`.
Authority: hand seat `player_index` only; freezes after `share_finalized`.

accounts.name: table_state
docs: Table that owns this hand; membership checked in the handler.

as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

fields.name: share_finalized
docs: True only after every player's Groth16 receipt and Arcis share hash agree.

fields.name: shared_cards
docs: Contiguous casino cards covered by finalized share rounds (lazy BJ prefix).
Reveal allows `card_index < shared_cards` when this is non-zero.

fields.name: showdown_finalized
docs: True only after light-casino `finalize_showdown` CPI-consumes the showdown receipt.

fields.name: pot_mask
docs: Poker only: fold / side-pot contestant bitmask. Zero for other games.

fields.name: game_id
docs: Game identifier

fields.name: async_generation
docs: Incremented for each queued async operation in this game.

fields.name: table_room_id
docs: Canonical table identity for this hand.

fields.name: num_players
docs: Number of players in this game

fields.name: num_cards
docs: Number of cards in the deck

fields.name: total_partials
docs: Total partials to reveal = num_cards * (num_players - 1)

fields.name: revealed_partials
docs: Partials revealed so far (partial units = n-1 per completed card; not limbs).

fields.name: staging_authority
docs: Rent payer of `deck_staging`; sole signer for `record_reveal` / `close_deck_staging`.

fields.name: phase
docs: Game phase: 0=registration, 1=shuffle, 2=share, 3=evaluation, 4=complete, 5=showdown, 6=pots_distributed

fields.name: betting_phase
docs: Betting phase: 0=not started, 1=preflop, 2=flop, 3=turn, 4=river, 5=showdown

fields.name: current_player
docs: Current player index (whose turn it is)

fields.name: current_bet
docs: Current bet amount to call

fields.name: last_aggressor
docs: Last aggressor player index

fields.name: last_aggressor_amount
docs: Last aggressor's bet amount

fields.name: folded_mask
docs: Bitmap of folded players

fields.name: show_on_fold_mask
docs: Bitmap of folded players who opted to show hole cards (else muck).

fields.name: all_in_mask
docs: Bitmap of all-in players

fields.name: shared_mask
docs: Bitmap of players who have submitted share partials (parallel share phase)

fields.name: hand_commits
docs: Per-street bet amounts during v2 betting (also legacy hand commits in v1).
Reset each street; seeded with blinds on PreFlop. Raise sets `current_bet`
from this tracker so callers can match (not `current_bet + bet_delta`).

fields.name: player_total_bets
docs: Legacy plaintext per-player totals — use `EncryptedGameBetting` in production.

fields.name: pots
docs: Legacy plaintext pots — use `EncryptedGameBetting.pots_ct` in production.

fields.name: pot_eligible_masks
docs: Eligible player mask per pot (folded players excluded)

fields.name: refunds
docs: Uncalled terminal contributions returned to their sole contributor.

fields.name: pot_count
docs: Number of valid pots in `pots` / `pot_eligible_masks`

fields.name: showdown_hash
docs: Polynomial hash commitment from showdown proof

fields.name: payouts
docs: Payout amounts per player after pot distribution

fields.name: verify_hash_acc
docs: Running Poseidon(4) sum (LE u128 low || u128 high), wrapping modulo 2^256.

fields.name: verify_expected
docs: Expected Poseidon(4) sum latched by `begin_verify_deck_hash`.

fields.name: verify_progress
docs: Number of distinct chunk callbacks applied (0..900)

fields.name: verify_bits
docs: Bitset of completed commitment indices (900 bits in 15×u64)

fields.name: verify_started
docs: True after begin_verify_deck_hash until all 900 chunks land

fields.name: acted_mask
docs: Bitmap of players who have acted on the current betting street.
Raises clear peers so action re-opens; street closes when all can-act bits are set and totals match.

fields.name: showdown_hash_player
docs: Player index whose Groth16 showdown proof produced `showdown_hash`.
Settlement (`compute_pots` / `distribute_and_settle`) MUST consume the
`SealedShowdownCoefficients` PDA seeded by this index — the sealed coeffs
used to build `showdown_hash` belong to this player only.

fields.name: bet_pending
docs: One queued bet may mutate the shared betting state at a time.

fields.name: bet_pending_operation
docs: Binds the MPC bet callback to the request that opened `bet_pending`.

fields.name: settlement_pending_operation
docs: Binds the settlement callback; retries are permitted after slot expiry.

fields.name: settlement_status
docs: V2 settlement state machine; see SETTLEMENT_* constants.

fields.name: settlement_generation
docs: Monotonic generation invalidates callbacks from a timed-out settlement.

fields.name: settlement_computation
docs: Arcium computation offset currently authorized to complete settlement.

fields.name: settlement_started_slot
docs: Slot at which the current all-seat settlement was queued.

fields.name: settlement_expiry_slot
docs: First slot at which the authority may refund a stalled settlement.

data objects.

types.name: Parameter
docs: A parameter of a computation.
We differentiate between plaintext and encrypted parameters and data objects.
Plaintext parameters are directly provided as their value.
Encrypted parameters are provided as an offchain reference to the data.
Data objects are provided as a reference to the data object account.

types.name: PendingDeposit
docs: One-time (accumulating) SPL→encrypted credit entitlement per player/room.
Created/accrued by `deposit_spl`; fully consumed by `request_credit_room_balance`.

types.name: PlayerActionRequired
docs: Emitted whenever a specific player must take an on-chain action.
Clients subscribe via program logs / `onLogs` and filter by `player_index`.

fields.name: encryption_pubkey
docs: X25519 owner public key that produced escrow ciphertexts (zero = unset).

fields.name: balance_u64
docs: Plaintext mirror of Enc hand stake (updated after Enc fund/net/return callbacks).

fields.name: pending_fund
docs: In-flight fund from table_escrow awaiting Enc callback (0 = idle).

fields.name: pending_net_abs
docs: In-flight net abs awaiting `apply_casino_player_net` callback.

fields.name: pending_net_won
docs: 1 if pending net is a win credit; 0 if a debit.

types.name: PlayerMpcKey
docs: Purpose-separated per-seat MPC transport key (Protocol V2).
Seeds: `[b"player_mpc_key", game_id, player_index, purpose, generation_le]`.

fields.name: show_on_fold
docs: Pending show-on-fold request for the in-flight `submit_bet` (default muck).

fields.name: accrued_ciphertext
docs: Encrypted staker accrual for selective reveal on redemption.

fields.name: total_commissions
docs: Cumulative transparent commission accrual (plaintext audit trail).

fields.name: total_withdrawn
docs: SPL already transferred out of the vault to the protocol.

types.name: RedeemDealerPoolOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: ReturnPlayerGameEscrowOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: RevealCardOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: RevealedCard
docs: Temporary PDA storing revealed threshold-decryption partials for ONE card.
The number of valid partials depends on the number of players:
- 2 players: 1 partial  = 4 values
- 5 players: 4 partials = 16 values
- 10 players: 9 partials = 36 values (max)
The `count` field stores how many values are valid (num_players - 1) * 4.
The remaining slots are zeroed and ignored.
Created by the Arcis reveal_card callback, closed by the client after
storing in a Light Protocol compressed account.

fields.name: generation
docs: Monotonic hand generation; prevents old reveal callbacks crossing hands.

fields.name: recipient_index
docs: Player whose public encryption key this section is sealed to.

fields.name: count
docs: Total expected BN254 values in `partials` (num_players - 1) * 4

fields.name: filled
docs: Number of distinct filled slots.

fields.name: filled_bits
docs: Exact coverage bitmap for the 36 possible slots.

fields.name: card_index
docs: Card index in the deck (0-based)

fields.name: recipient_authority
docs: Recipient signer authorized to read/close this record.

fields.name: refund_to
docs: Original account payer; receives the rent refund.

fields.name: pending_operation
docs: Each reveal job is generation- and computation-bound before its callback
may write a previously empty limb range.

fields.name: partials
docs: Resealed ciphertext partials. Max 36 values (10-player game).

fields.name: active_tables
docs: Bitmap: bit `table_id` set if seated at that table.

fields.name: in_hand_tables
docs: Bitmap: bit `table_id` set if in active hand at that table.

fields.name: balance_u64
docs: Personal escrow stack (chips available to transfer into seat escrows).
UI / validate_bet public-input mirror of `balance_ciphertext` — updated
only after successful Enc callbacks (see dual-ledger policy).

fields.name: pending_mirror_credit
docs: In-flight Enc credit amount awaiting callback mirror apply (0 = idle).

fields.name: encryption_pubkey
docs: X25519 owner public key that produced `balance_ciphertext` (zero = unset).

types.name: SealMxeRows
docs: `Enc<Mxe, [BaseField25519; 4]>` as the seal callbacks store it.
Appended after the fields Light and zig read, so those offsets stay put.

types.name: SealShowdownPairOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: SealedShowdownCoefficients
docs: Arcis-sealed showdown poly-hash coefficients for one proving player.
Produced by the pair seal and consumed by
`compute_pots` / `distribute_and_settle`. Seeds:
`[b"sealed_showdown_coeffs", owner]`.

fields.name: n_active
docs: Live polynomial terms. Every game seals two.

fields.name: coefficients_ciphertext
docs: Enc<Shared, [u128; 14]> ciphertexts

fields.name: coefficient_rows
docs: Subset-sum rows the seal commit revealed (big-endian, each below 2^253).
The showdown input hash Poseidon-binds these with the other statement fields.

fields.name: coefficient_commitment
docs: Kept so later fields stay at a fixed offset. The seal commit does not write it.

fields.name: input_nonce
docs: Nonce passed into the first seal. Slot `i` is encrypted under this plus `i`.
`nonce` is the Rescue nonce for slot 0 (the circuit advances the input by one).

fields.name: coeffs_needed
docs: Live polynomial terms. One `seal_showdown_pair` call writes both.

fields.name: coeffs_done
docs: Coefficient callbacks completed. The next slot is this index.

fields.name: folds_done
docs: Row-fold callbacks completed. Commit requires `folds_done + 1 == coeffs_needed`.

fields.name: row_latest
docs: MXE ciphertext of the latest coefficient's rows, waiting to be folded.

fields.name: row_acc
docs: Running sum of the row contributions.

fields.name: owner
docs: Seat wallet. The account address is this key, so the next hand can reuse
coefficients that a showdown has not consumed.

fields.name: consumed
docs: Set when settlement uses this seal.

fields.name: slot_done
docs: Bit `i` is set once coefficient slot `i` has landed.

types.name: SetUnset
docs: Utility struct to store a value that needs to be set by a certain number of participants (keys
in our case). Once all participants have set the value, the value is considered set and we only
store it once.

types.name: SettleCasinoHandV2Output
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

fields.name: share_cards
docs: Card window for this verify round (BJ chunk=16; else game.num_cards).

types.name: ShowdownMaterialCommitment
docs: Canonical sealed-limb reveal coverage for one showdown recipient.
Seeds: `[b"showdown_material", game_id, generation_le, recipient_index]`.
Each set bit means the corresponding showdown card has a complete,
recipient-scoped `RevealedCard` containing only Arcis-resealed ciphertext
limbs. Light/Circom hash those limbs directly; this account stores no digest.

fields.name: card_filled_bits
docs: Coverage over card indices 0..num_players*2+5 (at most 25 today).

types.name: StakeDealerPoolOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: StreetAdvancedEvent
docs: Emitted when a betting street closes after a bet callback and the next street (or Showdown) opens.

fields.name: balance_u64
docs: Seat escrow stack used for betting at this table.
Locked while `RoomWallet.in_hand_tables` has this table's bit set —
funds may only move into the pot (via `submit_bet` / validate_bet).
Mirror of Enc seat balance — updated only after Enc lock/unlock callbacks.

fields.name: pending_buy_in
docs: In-flight buy-in awaiting Enc `lock_table_buyin` callback (0 = idle).

fields.name: encryption_pubkey
docs: X25519 owner public key that produced `balance_ciphertext` (zero = unset).

fields.name: game_kind
docs: [`shared_zk_ids::GameKind`] as u8.

fields.name: shoe_decks
docs: Shoe decks for baccarat/blackjack/war (`1|6|8`); `1` for poker; `0` for roulette.

fields.name: roulette_variant
docs: Roulette variant (`37|38`); `0` for non-roulette tables.

types.name: UnlockTableOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

types.name: ValidateBetOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.

fields.name: game_id
docs: Game this callback-owned accumulator belongs to.

fields.name: verify_hash_acc
docs: Running Poseidon(4) sum (LE u128 low || u128 high), wrapping modulo 2^256.

fields.name: verify_expected
docs: Expected Poseidon(4) sum latched at the start of a verification round.

fields.name: verify_progress
docs: Number of commitments covered by delivered callbacks.

fields.name: verify_target
docs: Progress value at which verification is complete (used cards × active limbs).

fields.name: verify_bits
docs: Completion bitset for the 900 commitment indices.

fields.name: verified
docs: Final hash comparison result once all chunks arrive.

fields.name: verify_started
docs: True while chunk callbacks are expected.

types.name: VerifyDeckHashChunkOutput
docs: The output of the callback instruction. Provided as a struct with ordered fields
as anchor does not support tuples and tuple structs yet.
